screen: Add enquiry: phone matches several families
problem: Typing 9390011378 shows three warnings at once: an open enquiry for Ravi Teja (from Suresh Kumar), "belongs to Ramesh Reddy, parent of Aarav, Diya, Rohan, Vamsi, Bhavana, Yashwanth" and "belongs to Venkatesh, parent of Sri". Choosing "Add as sibling enquiry" then says only "Will be added as a sibling enquiry, linked to the same family". The saved enquiry's history says "Added as a sibling enquiry" and never names the family.
why_it_matters: With two families on one number the receptionist cannot tell whose sibling the new child became. The wrong family link carries into admission, fees and messages.
suggested_fix: When more than one family matches, make "Add as sibling" ask "Sibling of which family?" with one button per family. Name the chosen family in the confirmation line and in the activity entry, for example "Sibling of Sri Lakshmi (Venkatesh)".

problem: Owner is marked required (*) and shows the placeholder "Choose the owner", but the hint says "Usually leave as is". Saving without choosing works and quietly makes harikaa the owner.
why_it_matters: A first-timer stops to choose an owner she does not understand, or worries the form will fail. The hint contradicts what the screen shows.
suggested_fix: Pre-fill the field with the signed-in person ("harikaa (you)") so "leave as is" is true, or drop the asterisk and say "Blank = you".

problem: In the form, Source offers Walk-in, Phone, Referral, Website and Other. The list filter beside it offers Walk-in, Phone, Website, WhatsApp, Campaign and Referral. "Other" cannot be filtered, and "WhatsApp" and "Campaign" cannot be chosen.
why_it_matters: Enquiries saved as "Other" cannot be found again by source, and the two lists look like different systems.
suggested_fix: Use one source list in the form, the filter and the reports.

problem: In November 2026 a new admission enquiry defaults to "For year 2026-27", and "class 1 · 23 seats left" counts the current year. Parents who enquire in November usually want next June (2027-28).
why_it_matters: New-year enquiries get filed under the running year. Seat counts and the conversion reports then mix this year with next year.
suggested_fix: From about October, default to the next academic year, or make the receptionist pick the year, with seats shown for the year picked.

problem: The tile says "Follow-ups due today 0 · Nothing due" (Desk: "No follow-ups due today"), yet the table right below lists Ravi Teja with "Today, 11:00 AM". The Dashboard says "1 follow-up today", and the Admissions list shows "Follow-up today 1". Grammar on the tiles: "0 calls 1 enquiries", "1 calls 1 enquiries".
why_it_matters: The receptionist trusts the tile, skips the call, and the enquiry goes cold.
suggested_fix: Count Follow-ups due today with the same query the Admissions "Follow-up today" chip uses, and include overdue ones. Fix the singular and plural forms.

screen: Student Pickup: student already has a pass
problem: Sri Lakshmi already has gate pass GP-2026-0002, "Waiting at the gate" since 4:48 AM. Choosing Sri again shows the normal "Who is collecting?" picker with no warning. The help line says "Someone in red cannot be chosen", but nobody is red.
why_it_matters: A second receptionist could issue a duplicate pass for a child who is already at the gate, or one who has already left.
suggested_fix: When the chosen student has an open pass today, show a banner at the top ("Sri already has pass GP-2026-0002, waiting at the gate, made 4:48 AM by Saiveni") with Open pass and Cancel pass buttons. Show the "red" hint only when someone is red.

problem: Searching "Sri" also returns "harika, Class 1 A". It matches her parent "srinu", but the result row does not show the parent, so the match looks random.
why_it_matters: This makes the receptionist doubt the search, especially at the gate.
suggested_fix: Show the matched parent name in the result row, as Collect fee already does ("Roll 1 · srinu").

problem: The staff chip row is cut off at "Receptionist · har...". KUSUMA appears only in the "Someone else" dropdown, not as a chip. Slots from 10:00 to 12:45 are grouped under one "10:00 AM" row label.
why_it_matters: Cut text and a missing teacher make the receptionist think KUSUMA cannot be booked. The single row label is hard to read.
suggested_fix: Wrap the chips or add a visible scroll hint, list every bookable staff member, and label each row by its hour (10, 11, 12).

problem: After the phone is typed, the form shows "Ramesh Reddy · Father of ..." but leaves the required "Visitor name" box empty. The New visitor form fills the name by itself.
why_it_matters: It means extra typing, and the same lookup behaves differently on two forms.
suggested_fix: Fill Visitor name from the matched guardian, the same way the visitor form does.

problem: Pressing Esc on the New visitor form (to close a dropdown) closed the whole dialog. The typed phone was lost without a warning.
why_it_matters: Front-desk staff often press Esc. With a queue at the desk, losing the form is annoying.
suggested_fix: Keep the dialog open on Esc when fields are filled, or keep the draft and restore it when the form opens again.

problem: With Telugu chosen, almost everything is translated. Left in English: the "Add a note" placeholder on Front-office notes and the "Export" button on Appointments.
why_it_matters: These are small gaps, but they show on the two busiest desk screens.
suggested_fix: Add the two strings to the Telugu (and Hindi) word lists.

problem: The chart's y-axis repeats "1, 1" and shows only a Mon bar, with no other days of the week.
why_it_matters: It looks broken, and a chart with one day says nothing.
suggested_fix: Use whole-number ticks without repeats, and show all days Monday to Saturday with zero bars.

problem: Owner shows "Not given yet" here and "No owner" in Admissions. The footnote says "Owner and follow-up are set by Admissions as soon as the enquiry is saved", but two rows have no owner. Overdue dates (14-11) are red in Admissions and plain here.
why_it_matters: The same data looks different on the two screens, and the footnote is not true for these rows.
suggested_fix: Use one word ("No owner"), mark overdue dates red here too, and fix or drop the footnote.

problem: Log a call defaults Purpose to "Fee", although "Admission enquiry" is the first option. A phone shared by several guardians fills in "Ramesh Reddy" with no way to pick Venkatesh. On Walk-in request, the Phone box disappears once a parent is picked, so the receptionist cannot see which number gets the WhatsApp.
why_it_matters: This gives wrong call statistics and causes doubt about where the request number was sent.
suggested_fix: Leave Purpose empty (required), offer a choice when a phone matches several guardians, and keep the phone visible after picking ("WhatsApp to 93900 11378").

problem: Six old passes must be closed one by one, each through its own "Check out laxmi?" dialog. There is no "close all left before today" option.
why_it_matters: Six dialogs every morning is tedious, so the warning stays on the dashboard for days.
suggested_fix: Add "Close all from earlier days" with one time (for example closing time) and one confirmation.

problem: The same class appears as "class 1" (Admissions), "Class 1 A" (Pickup), "class 1 A" (Fees) and "1 A" (Dashboard).
why_it_matters: Inconsistent names make the app feel unfinished.
suggested_fix: Use one format everywhere (for example "Class 1 A", with "Class 1" for class-level items).

problem: The accountant's urgent list leads with "6 visitor passes expired with nobody checked out", which is Front Office work. The only money item is "9 staff members have no salary structure".
why_it_matters: It is noise in the accountant's most important box and teaches her to ignore it.
suggested_fix: Show visitor-pass items only to roles that can check visitors out (Receptionist, Admin).

problem: Amount received opens already filled with the full ₹19,798, and the big blue button reads "Collect ₹19,798". A parent paying ₹2,000 needs the accountant to clear and retype the amount first.
why_it_matters: One tap before typing posts a ₹19,798 cash receipt that never happened. Undoing it needs a cancellation with a reason and approval.
suggested_fix: Start the amount empty with the Full, Half and Quarter chips as one-tap fills, or ask for confirmation when the amount equals the full due and the mode is Cash.

problem: Receipt C-CHE-001/2026-27/00011 (15-11-2026, ₹100) shows "Still to pay now ₹19,798", which is today's balance. The balance right after that receipt was ₹19,900.
why_it_matters: A reprinted old receipt shows a number that does not match the ledger line. Parents and auditors will question it.
suggested_fix: Show "Balance after this receipt ₹19,900". If today's balance is also wanted, label it separately ("Today: ₹19,798").

problem: Opening the ledger for Sri showed a blank grey page for about 4-5 s before anything appeared, with no loading skeleton.
why_it_matters: A blank page at the counter looks like a crash, and the accountant clicks again or leaves.
suggested_fix: Show the page frame and a skeleton at once, and load the statement after.

problem: The summary row has "Academic fee ₹202 of ₹20,000", then two empty boxes, then "Year total". The tabs "Payments 4" and "Partial payments 4" look the same.
why_it_matters: The empty boxes look broken, and the two tabs do not say how they differ.
suggested_fix: Let the boxes fill the row (or hide empty ones), and merge the tabs or explain them ("Partial = less than the due").

screen: Collect fee: who to contact for QR/online
problem: The note reads "Show QR and the payment link are off: online payment is not set up yet. Tell DREAM TEAM support." Elsewhere the same vendor is called "School OS support team".
why_it_matters: Staff do not know who "DREAM TEAM" is or how to reach them.
suggested_fix: Use one name everywhere and give a way to reach them (phone or WhatsApp link, or "Ask your School Admin").

problem: The biggest button on the Day Book is a blue "Close today", shown at 5:37 AM with no hint of what it does.
why_it_matters: A first-timer may think it closes the page, or close the day by accident before evening collections.
suggested_fix: Rename it to "Close today's books..." with a one-line hint, and show it only after a set time or once the cash count is entered.

screen: Fee Dashboard vs Day Book year
problem: The Day Book says "Money is counted by the financial year, April to March". The Fee Dashboard chart runs Jun to Apr, with no May.
why_it_matters: Mixed year definitions make month totals hard to match.
suggested_fix: Label each one ("Academic year Jun-Apr", "Financial year Apr-Mar"), or let the chart follow one rule and say which.

problem: The "Send fee reminders" quick action opens Defaulters, where the top-right button is "Send reminder to all 29" (after a bucket tap, "Send reminder to 14"). Not clicked in this test, so a confirmation step was not checked.
why_it_matters: One mis-tap can WhatsApp 29 families and spend credits.
suggested_fix: Make sure a summary step appears (who, how many, credits, the message preview), and make the default action "Choose who to remind".

problem: Tapping "0 to 30 days ₹2.13 L" lists students whose row says "Oldest due 10-06-2026 · 159 days" and the full ₹30,000. Ageing is counted per installment, but each row shows the oldest due and the total.
why_it_matters: The accountant sees 159-day defaulters inside the "0 to 30 days" bucket and stops trusting the page.
suggested_fix: In a bucket view, show the amount and due date that fall in that bucket ("₹10,000 due 10-11, 6 days"), or say "has at least one installment 0-30 days late".

problem: The Fee Dashboard says "Collected this year ₹1.54 L". Fee Reports shows a Collection report total of ₹1,55,202 (12 payments), which would read 1.55 L. Approvals show a ₹1,000 refund (Tarun Prasad), which probably explains the gap, but neither page says net or gross.
why_it_matters: Principals and auditors compare these two pages first, and a ₹1,000 gap without a label looks like lost money.
suggested_fix: Label them "Collected (before refunds)" and "Net of refunds ₹X", and use the same rule on the dashboard tile and the report.

problem: aksha's own profile says Two-step login is "Required for your role, but no code can reach you yet, so you sign in with your password only ... Not set up". Settings > Users shows aksha with Two-step login "On".
why_it_matters: The School Admin believes the money role is protected by a second step when it is not.
suggested_fix: In the Users list, show "On - not working (no phone/email)" in amber, and add an item to the admin's "Needs your attention".

problem: With Telugu chosen, the main button stays English ("Collect ₹19,798"). Also in English: "Discount, waiver, date or note", "Academic fee · Year 2026-27", "Due 14-11-2026", "1 row" and "Today, 16-11-2026". The two-step text on the profile is half English.
why_it_matters: The most-used money button on the most-used money page ignores the language the user chose.
suggested_fix: Translate the Collect fee page strings, the fee head and due labels, and the profile two-step text.

problem: The list header reads "OVERDUE, MOST LIKELY AT THE COUNTER TODAY".
why_it_matters: The wording is odd, and it is not clear how the app knows who comes today.
suggested_fix: Use "Overdue - largest first" or "Often pay at the counter".

problem: The Dashboard (Teacher, Principal and Admin) says "6 students in class 1 A below 50% or not passing in Unit Test 1 QA: Vihaan Rao, Saanvi Kumar, Diya Sharma and 3 more". Their papers are grade-only: TELUGU A, A, B and SOCIAL C, B, B. The Results page opened by "See students" shows Total 0/0, an empty %, "Class average 0%", "Passed 0 of 6" and also "Did not pass 0".
why_it_matters: The app wrongly flags good students as failing to the teacher, the principal and possibly parents. The contradictory numbers also undo trust in every other alert.
suggested_fix: Leave grade-only subjects out of percentage and pass checks (or map grades to pass/fail by the grading scale). Raise the "below 50%" alert only when a percentage exists. Make "Passed" and "Did not pass" add up.

problem: KUSUMA's approved casual leave is listed as "Today · Your casual leave Mon 16 Nov". The same dashboard still asks her to "Take attendance for class 1 A · Locks at 11:00 AM" and lists "Invigilation: TELUGU, class 2 · 4:00 PM". Nothing says who covers.
why_it_matters: The teacher on leave feels she must log in and work. Class 1 A attendance and the invigilation may be missed because nobody else is told.
suggested_fix: On a leave day, replace the duties with "You are on leave today; class 1 A attendance and the 4 PM invigilation need cover". Show the same item to the Principal/Admin with a link to Academics > Substitutions.

screen: Take Attendance: looks done when not saved
problem: Before anything is saved, the page shows "17 of 17 marked · 17 present · 0 absent" with a full green progress bar. The only sign is the grey banner "Not saved yet".
why_it_matters: A teacher who glances at it believes attendance is done, closes the page, and the class stays "Not taken".
suggested_fix: Until saved, show "Not saved - 17 will be saved as present" in amber, keep the bar grey or amber, and turn it green only after the save.

problem: After only looking at the page, with no taps, typing another address made the browser show the "Leave site? Changes you made may not be saved" box.
why_it_matters: This scares a teacher who changed nothing, and teaches her to ignore the warning when it matters.
suggested_fix: Only warn when the teacher has actually changed a mark.

screen: Take Attendance: H, E, M letters
problem: The buttons P, A, L, H, E, LV, M have a legend for only P, A, L and LV. H (Half-day), E (Excused) and M (Medical) are explained only by mouse hover, which phones do not have. With Telugu chosen, all letters stay English.
why_it_matters: Teachers guess the meaning or never use those marks.
suggested_fix: Add H, E and M to the legend with full words (translated), or show the full word under each letter on wide screens.

problem: Sri Lakshmi left early today at 4:48 AM on gate pass GP-2026-0002 (a notification says so). On Take Attendance she shows as a plain "P" with no "left early" hint.
why_it_matters: The register says the child was in school all day after a guardian took her. That matters for safety and for disputes.
suggested_fix: Show a "Left early 4:48 AM" tag on the student's row and suggest Half-day.

problem: "Write numbers 1 to 50" for class 1 A says "16 assigned", but the class has 17 students. "exercise 4" (aswini, SOCIAL 2 A) says "5 assigned" for 16 students. Nothing says who was left out or why.
why_it_matters: Teachers think a child was dropped by mistake, and parents of the missing child get nothing.
suggested_fix: Show "16 of 17 - not given to: Sri Lakshmi (joined later)" with an "Add" button, the same way Marks shows "Joined late + Add".

problem: The footnote says "parents of 17 students also get one message each (about 1 credit each)". The tile says "16 pieces of work for 1 class".
why_it_matters: "Credit" means nothing to a teacher (it costs money), and "pieces of work" is jargon.
suggested_fix: Write "17 WhatsApp messages (paid by the school)" and "16 students given homework".

problem: In One person, the search result for Sri Lakshmi is labelled "Student". Picking her shows "Nobody to send to", "0 people" and "1 students get app messages only (Sri Lakshmi)". The teacher wanted Sri's father.
why_it_matters: The teacher is stuck with no hint that she must search for the parent instead.
suggested_fix: When a student is picked, add the guardians automatically (or offer "Send to Sri's parent Venkatesh?"), and fix "1 students".

problem: A class teacher's WhatsApp template list has about 33 entries, including Salary slip ready, Visitor pass, Admission consent code, Bus arriving, Picked up by the bus, Dropped by the bus, WhatsApp connection test and Birthday wishes (staff). The hint "Message type: General - Sets which templates are offered" did not shorten the list.
why_it_matters: The teacher is overwhelmed and could send a wrong template (for example, a bus message when the school has no bus routes).
suggested_fix: Filter templates by message type and role, and hide system or test templates and any module the school has no data for.

problem: After sending to Venkatesh the status stayed "Queued · Waiting to go" until the page was reloaded by hand. After the reload it said "Sent to WhatsApp · Delivery reports are not connected", "Delivered 0 (0%)", with a big blue "Resend to 1 unread" button seconds after sending.
why_it_matters: The teacher thinks the message failed and resends it, which doubles the parent's messages and the credits.
suggested_fix: Refresh the status by itself. While delivery reports are off, hide "Delivered/Read 0%" and the Resend-to-unread button, or say "Sent - WhatsApp does not tell us when it is read".

problem: The automatic message reads "Your salary slip is ready. Open it in My profile". Slips live under the sidebar item "My salary slips", not in My profile.
why_it_matters: The pointer sends staff to the wrong place.
suggested_fix: Change the text to "Open it in My salary slips" and make it a link.

problem: "Unit Test 1 QA is on · ends Thu", although its TELUGU paper was on 10-11 and marks are already submitted. The left column ends after My tasks, leaving a large empty area while the right column runs long.
why_it_matters: The status is confusing, and the page looks unbalanced.
suggested_fix: Say "Unit Test 1: marks being entered (ends Thu)" and rebalance the columns.

problem: With Telugu chosen: "locks 11:00 AM", "Locks at 11:00 AM" and "class 1 A" stay English.
why_it_matters: These are small gaps on the first screen a teacher sees.
suggested_fix: Add these strings to the translation lists.

problem: The class chip "class 2 A" wraps onto two lines ("class 2 / A"). The Exams page has no breadcrumb, unlike the other pages.
why_it_matters: Small layout glitches.
suggested_fix: Stop the chip from wrapping, or widen it, and add the breadcrumb.

screen: Attendance letters: H means two things
problem: On Take Attendance, the H button means Half-day (tooltip). On the Attendance Register, the legend says "H Holiday", and 5 Nov ("toofan") shows H for every child.
why_it_matters: A child marked H for half-day reads as "Holiday" in the register, and the reverse. This is the kind of mix-up that leads to wrong attendance percentages and parent disputes.
suggested_fix: Give each mark its own letter (for example HD for Half-day, HOL or a grey dot for Holiday) and use the same legend on both pages.

problem: aswini has three parent appointments today (10:45 radha, 11:00 Venkatesh, 12:00 Ramesh Reddy). Her dashboard's "Today and next" shows only exams. The appointments appear only as bell notifications.
why_it_matters: Teachers miss parent meetings, and the parent waits at reception.
suggested_fix: Add the teacher's appointments to "Today and next" (time, parent, purpose).

problem: "Unit Test 1 QA: SOCIAL marks for class 1 A are due today. 6 of 17 students entered." appears twice (13 min and 6 h ago).
why_it_matters: Repeated alerts become noise.
suggested_fix: Merge them into one item that updates.

screen: Time Table empty but homework knows next class
problem: Time Table says "No Time Table yet - appears once the school publishes it", and the dashboard says "Classes today 0". Yet Give homework (KUSUMA) says "Next TELUGU class: Tue 17 Nov" and offers Due "Next class".
why_it_matters: The due date comes from a timetable the teacher cannot see, so it may be wrong. Teachers also wonder why Monday has no classes.
suggested_fix: If no timetable is published, hide "Next class" (offer Tomorrow or Pick a date). Otherwise show where the date came from.

problem: The header says "12 school days so far · 94.3% present", but 9 of the 12 days are "not marked". Rohan Chowdary shows 50% in red, from 2 marked days (1 absent).
why_it_matters: A red 50% on a child after 2 days looks alarming, and it feeds into early warnings and parent views.
suggested_fix: Show "3 of 12 days marked" next to the %, and do not colour red until enough days are marked.

screen: Marks entry wording on a grade paper
problem: On the grade-only SOCIAL paper, the help says "Absent (AB) Counted as 0 marks" and gives typing tips for marks. The stat "Graded 6 of 17" sits next to the pill "Graded", which means the paper type.
why_it_matters: The same word means two things, and "marks" is the wrong word for a grade paper.
suggested_fix: Use "Entered 6 of 17" and "Grade paper", and say "Absent - no grade".

problem: The subtitle reads "SOCIAL · 2 A · only your classes and subjects", but aswini also teaches SOCIAL in 1 A.
why_it_matters: It looks as if class 1 A is missing.
suggested_fix: List every class she teaches, or say "your classes".

problem: The Dashboard quick action "Who is absent today" opens "Absent 0 · Nobody absent · No student is marked absent on 16-11-2026", although neither class 1 A nor 2 A has taken attendance today.
why_it_matters: At the main "is everything okay?" moment the principal is told everyone is present. A missing child would not be noticed.
suggested_fix: When classes have not taken attendance, say so first: "Attendance not taken yet: class 1 A (teacher on leave), class 2 A (no class teacher)", and show "0 absent" only for classes that are marked.

screen: Dashboard: teacher on leave, class uncovered
problem: "Staff on leave today: KUSUMA" and "Students present: Not taken" both show, but "Needs your attention" (9 items) has nothing like "class 1 A has no teacher today". The app has a Substitutions tab.
why_it_matters: The class may go without attendance or a teacher, and the principal must connect the dots herself.
suggested_fix: Add an attention item "class 1 A: class teacher on leave - give attendance and periods to someone" that links to Substitutions.

problem: Early Warnings opens on "Attendance and marks", where everything is 0 (Act now 0, Watch 0). The Dashboard says 6 class 1 A students are below 50%. Its rule card says the pass mark is 33%. The Fees view shows 26 Watch, and even 159 days overdue is only "Watch", not "Act now".
why_it_matters: Two screens give the principal opposite answers about student health.
suggested_fix: Use one rule for "weak" across the Dashboard and Early Warnings, open on "All", and move very old dues to "Act now".

problem: The accountant's dashboard says "9 staff members have no salary structure: aswinitha, aksha and 7 more - left out of November salary". Staff & HR says "6 staff on roll". aswinitha is a disabled login.
why_it_matters: Counts bigger than the staff list look like a bug, and they push salary work for people who have left.
suggested_fix: Count only active staff in the salary checks.

problem: The card titled "Fees by class" actually lists months (Jun 0% ... Nov 19%).
why_it_matters: The title does not match the content.
suggested_fix: Rename it to "Fees collected by month", or show classes.

screen: Reports and approvals: modules the school does not use
problem: All Reports lists 98 reports, including Transport 7, Library 7 and Hostel 8. These modules have no data here and are not in the principal's menu. The Approvals "Kind" filter has 30 kinds, including Transport change, Hostel outing pass and Library lost book. A "Large" tag on some reports is not explained.
why_it_matters: It is overwhelming for a first-time principal, and the empty reports look broken.
suggested_fix: Hide reports and approval kinds for modules switched off or unused in the principal's menu, and explain "Large" (for example "may take a minute").

problem: "Attendance by class" rows are labelled just "1" and "2", with stray "1 2" chips under them. The date picker text is cut off ("15-06-20...").
why_it_matters: It looks unfinished.
suggested_fix: Label the rows "Class 1" and "Class 2", remove the stray chips, and widen the date control.

problem: Each request shows "Approved" or "Rejected" but not who decided or when.
why_it_matters: The principal must open each request to see who approved a refund.
suggested_fix: Add "by anjali, 14-11 11:30 PM" next to the status.

problem: The "Set" button opens the whole Classes & Sections list, not class 2 A's edit. Each row has an "Archive" button next to "Edit".
why_it_matters: There is one more search step, and Archive is easy to hit by mistake.
suggested_fix: Open class 2 A's class-teacher picker directly, and move Archive into a "..." menu.

problem: "6 staff on roll · 3 teaching, 3 others", but the list shows two Teachers (KUSUMA, aswini). The Principal is probably counted as teaching.
why_it_matters: Small number doubts add up.
suggested_fix: Say what counts as teaching, or count by designation.

problem: The footer says "39 templates", but the table shows only 25 rows (checked: 25 rows in the table) and has no paging or "show more". Everything after Homework (the Parent Link, Queries, Staff and Transport categories, for example "Salary slip ready") can only be found by searching. The Credit history on Settings does have paging.
why_it_matters: The admin cannot see or edit 14 templates and thinks they do not exist. On the new Templates page this blocks the job it was built for.
suggested_fix: Add paging (or show all 39), keep the footer count equal to the rows shown, and offer group-by-category.

screen: Send Message: Whole school by default
problem: For the School Admin, Send Message opens with "Whole school" already selected (8 parents, 8 credits), with a red "Emergency broadcast" button beside it.
why_it_matters: The admin types a note meant for one parent, presses Send, and every family gets it.
suggested_fix: Start with nothing selected and make the admin choose who gets it. Keep Emergency broadcast visually apart.

problem: The AI assistant checkbox is unticked, but its label says "AI assistant is on", and the line below says "Switch on the AI assistant first".
why_it_matters: The admin cannot tell whether AI is on.
suggested_fix: Make the label follow the state ("AI assistant: Off / On").

problem: The tiles say "Links active 1" and "Opened in last 30 days 1 · 100% of guardians", while "Families with no link" is 7 out of 8.
why_it_matters: The admin reads "100%" as every parent using it.
suggested_fix: Count the % against all guardians ("1 of 8 · 13%"), or say "100% of links sent".

problem: The dashboard says "8 of 8 guardians have not given data consent". Parent Link shows Venkatesh gave consent ("Photos of my child", given 16-11-2026, "1 given"). The consent card also lists "Photos of my child" twice with identical text.
why_it_matters: Privacy consent numbers must be right, because the school may need to show them.
suggested_fix: Use one consent count on both screens, and merge or explain the duplicate form rows.

problem: The vendor is called "DREAM TEAM" on Payment Gateways, the SMS card and the fee page, and "School OS support team" on the AI, Integrations and SMS pages. No phone or link is given.
why_it_matters: Staff do not know who to call.
suggested_fix: Use one name with a contact link everywhere.

problem: The AI feature texts are long and technical, for example "Preparing actions as a filled form (Do) is not built yet" and "from the headings only".
why_it_matters: A school admin cannot judge what to switch on, and "not built yet" sounds unfinished.
suggested_fix: Give each feature one short sentence of benefit, put the details behind "More", and leave "not built yet" out of the UI.

screen: Transport, Library and Hostel switched on with no data
problem: For this school, Transport, Library, Inventory and Hostel are all On in Modules and in the menu, with no routes or books. The Parent Link "School bus" section is on. The owner decision was "no Transport in version 1".
why_it_matters: Empty modules make the product look half-done, and parents may see an empty bus card.
suggested_fix: Owner to confirm. If v1 has no Transport, switch these off by default for new schools and hide the matching Parent Link sections.

screen: Template detail: technical name and Archive
problem: The details show the technical name "new_notice_2a7c8f_v4". The red "Archive" button sits right next to "Edit".
why_it_matters: This is jargon, and an accidental archive could stop automatic notices.
suggested_fix: Hide the technical name under "More details", and move Archive into a "..." menu.

problem: The line "Each module keeps its own rules on its last page" is hard to understand.
why_it_matters: The admin does not know where module settings live.
suggested_fix: Write "Each module has its own Settings tab (for example Fees > Fee Settings)".

problem: The "Staff present 0/6" tile shows an empty ring that looks like a loading spinner.
